answer: Give every identity a lantern of earned reputation: newcomers start hollow, with no voting or earning rights, and gain them only through a public history of verified, useful work. A whisper of trust follows each completed task, and a thousand clones would each have to build that history from scratch — no shared shortcut exists. The cost is time and consistent work, not money, so a sybil farmer pays in months of labor per fake. Limit: honest newcomers face a slow cold start, and patient farmers can pre-age farms, so reputation must decay without continued work.
